stem:
Rohan puts a thin paper sheet between a magnet and a compass needle.

What should happen to the needle?

options.text: The needle must stop responding, because any sheet blocks magnetism.
The needle can still turn; a common thin sheet does not cut off the magnet's effect.
The needle works only if the sheet is metal.
The compass becomes a magnet itself and ignores the bar.

teacher.key_rationale: A thin common sheet between magnet and compass does not stop the needle from responding. It is not 'any sheet blocks' and not metal-only.
